brief.sections.B1.content.value: Role, path, credentials (F1/F2). Org in its own words + what changed (F3/F4). Status + coverage line.

brief.sections.B2.content.value: 2-3 exact quotes with [n]; or 'Themes from their public presence' if none (F5/F6).

brief.sections.B3.content.value: Why this meeting matters to THEM. Pressure, priority, where the caller's offer connects. Counter-evidence acknowledged in one clause (F12).

brief.sections.B4.content.value: Six rows: dimension | band | meaning-for-the-meeting | [n]. 'no read' where tier is missing. Tier gate line.

brief.sections.B5.content.value: 4-6 questions, each <= 40 words, each with 'What the answer tells you' and a [n]. Mix set by meeting.format.

brief.sections.B6.content.value: Gap -> Bridge (outcome, not method) -> Urgency, in their language, each step with a [n].

brief.sections.B7.content.value: One thing of value to bring; the ask; the fallback ask.

brief.sections.B8.content.value: Pace/language from B4; [UNVERIFIED] items to confirm; topics left out on purpose; never-say list.

brief.sections.B9.content.value: Cited claims only: [n] claim -- URL -- DIRECT|SEARCH -- C-level -- date. Coverage fraction on the last line.

calibration.rules.CAL-1.test.value: Delete the profile and run -- the run must ask. Run again -- it must not.

calibration.rules.CAL-1.text.value: Ask all eight questions only when ~/.pcp/profile.yaml is missing, invalid, or --recalibrate is passed. Otherwise read it silently.

calibration.rules.CAL-2.test.value: Skip Q5 -- profile shows research.depth standard, defaulted true; footer reads "standard".

calibration.rules.CAL-2.text.value: A skipped answer takes the first (Recommended) option and is stored with defaulted:true; the PDF footer shows the profile line.

calibration.rules.CAL-3.test.value: Three debriefs with facts_used > 80% must produce a proposal, and the profile must be unchanged until answered.

calibration.rules.CAL-3.text.value: The improve loop may PROPOSE a profile change (one line, with the debrief evidence) but never applies one without a yes.

checks.C1.passes_when.value: no sentence in B1-B7 lacks both a [n] and a target-specific noun

checks.C2.passes_when.value: unbound == 0 and every [n] in the body exists in B9 with url+tag+date

checks.C3.passes_when.value: every quoted string in B2 has a [n]

checks.C5.passes_when.value: B1-B9 and P1-P7 present in order (P5 may be omitted per S3-2)

checks.C6.passes_when.value: no section exceeds its words by > 15%

checks.C7.passes_when.value: no never_say phrase appears outside P7/B8

checks.C8.passes_when.value: B6 Bridge contains no method verbs from checks.method_verbs

checks.C9.passes_when.value: no excluded topic keyword appears in the body

eval.definition.value: decision-useful fact = a claim [n] that is (a) cited in B1-B7 or P1-P6, (b) present in B9 with url + tag + date, (c) target-specific (passes swap). duf_pp = count / pages.

script.blocks.P3.content.value: 5 questions verbatim from B5, ordered for the room.

script.blocks.P4.content.value: 3 objection -> response pairs, each response <= 30 words.

script.blocks.P5.content.value: ONLY if tier high AND authority high: 3 moves from B4 meanings. Otherwise this block is omitted, not blank.

script.blocks.P6.content.value: The ask, the fallback, the follow-up promise.

stages.S1.rows.S1-1.test.value: Run with a name only -- the run must ask, not search.

stages.S1.rows.S1-1.text.value: Do not start research without a full name and an organisation.

stages.S1.rows.S1-2.test.value: Seed an ambiguous name -- the run must present the candidates and stop.

stages.S1.rows.S1-2.text.value: Two or more people match the name: stop and ask which one. Wrong-person research is worse than none.

stages.S1.rows.S1-3.test.value: A 9-row CSV must be refused with the count.

stages.S1.rows.S1-3.text.value: Up to 8 targets per run; research targets in parallel, write briefs in turn.

value.name: resolved_families
value.source: families filtered by profile (kind, depth, socmint)

stages.S2.rows.S2-1.test.value: A LinkedIn login wall counts as a failed URL and appears in coverage.failed_urls.

stages.S2.rows.S2-1.text.value: Public sources only. Nothing behind a login, no paid data the user has not supplied, no scraping.

stages.S2.rows.S2-2.test.value: A claim missing any field is dropped by eval.py claims and counted in coverage.dropped.

stages.S2.rows.S2-2.text.value: Every claim carries url, retrieved_at, tag DIRECT|SEARCH, and confidence C1 (primary, dated) | C2 (reputable secondary) | C3 (single weak source) | C4 (inferred).

stages.S2.rows.S2-3.basis.value: original plugin v1 + every rule carries a falsification test

stages.S2.rows.S2-3.test.value: Seed a claim tagged exclusion health -- it must not appear in any output file.

stages.S2.rows.S2-3.text.value: A claim that hits an exclusion is dropped BEFORE the writer sees it and counted in coverage.excluded; the brief's guardrails say a topic was left out, never which fact.

stages.S2.rows.S2-4.test.value: Disable WebFetch -- coverage must show 0/N attempted and status LIMITED, never FULL.

stages.S2.rows.S2-4.text.value: Coverage is a required output: families_attempted/families_total and hits per family. A run without coverage is not a run.

stages.S2.rows.S2-5.test.value: Remove all C1/C2 claims from one family below threshold -- status flips to LIMITED.

stages.S2.rows.S2-5.text.value: Status FULL requires >= 1 C1/C2 claim in >= research.full_threshold[depth] families; else LIMITED, stamped on page 1.

stages.S2.rows.S2-6.test.value: With depth standard or deep, coverage must show family F12 attempted.

stages.S2.rows.S2-6.text.value: Run the counter-evidence family last: search for what would contradict the strategic read.

stages.S3.rows.S3-1.test.value: A target with only role-archetype claims must render every dimension as tier low and the script must contain no influence sequence.

stages.S3.rows.S3-1.text.value: Score each of the six dimensions only from observation_ids in claims.jsonl; a band with fewer observations than its tier minimum is reported as 'no read' -- never guessed from role.

stages.S3.rows.S3-2.test.value: Delete one corroborating claim -- the tier must drop and the influence sequence must disappear on re-run.

stages.S3.rows.S3-2.text.value: Evidence tier gates script depth: low -> opener + questions; medium -> + framing; high -> + influence sequence (only if authority_level high).

stages.S3.rows.S3-3.test.value: Grep the brief for a band phrase not in rubric.*.meaning -- concordance fails.

stages.S3.rows.S3-3.text.value: Every band phrase on the page is a rubric row in pcp.yaml; no band phrase is written in prose.

stages.S3.rows.S3-4.test.value: Depth standard -- no ACH block; depth deep -- ACH block with a disconfirming claim id per hypothesis.

stages.S3.rows.S3-4.text.value: Depth deep adds an ACH mini: <= 3 hypotheses about what the target wants from this meeting, each with the claim that would disconfirm it.

stages.S4.rows.S4-1.test.value: eval.py duf reports unbound > 0 -- the run must rewrite before render.

stages.S4.rows.S4-1.text.value: Every fact in the brief cites a claim id [n]; the Sources block lists only cited claims. A fact with no citation is a defect, not a style choice.

stages.S4.rows.S4-2.basis.value: original plugin check 1, tightened to sentence

stages.S4.rows.S4-2.test.value: A brief with a sentence containing no claim id and no target-specific noun fails checks.swap.

stages.S4.rows.S4-2.text.value: Every sentence passes the swap test against caller.offer_one_line and the target: if another target's name would leave it true, delete it.

stages.S4.rows.S4-3.test.value: The output directory contains exactly one .pdf and no .md/.html after a run.

stages.S4.rows.S4-3.text.value: Render ONLY through format/talyx_pdf.py with --max-pages 3; never emit Markdown or HTML as the deliverable.

stages.S4.rows.S4-4.test.value: Feed a 900-word section -- the engine must exit non-zero naming the section.

stages.S4.rows.S4-4.text.value: If the tightest density rung still overflows 3 pages, the run FAILS with the section word counts; it never truncates or spills.

stages.S4.rows.S4-5.test.value: Extract page-3 footer text -- all four fields present.

stages.S4.rows.S4-5.text.value: The PDF footer carries: profile line, research status, duf_pp, coverage fraction.

value: the pcp.yaml rows the debrief touches

value.name: debrief.yaml
value.source: user, after the call (60 seconds, 4 fields)

stages.S5.rows.S5-1.test.value: Lower a family weight so a target's duf_pp drops -- ratchet must exit non-zero and name the target.

stages.S5.rows.S5-1.text.value: A change to pcp.yaml lands only if eval.py ratchet passes: every frozen target's duf_pp >= its floor AND all checks pass. The floor is the best ever seen and only rises.

stages.S5.rows.S5-2.test.value: The debrief template has exactly four fields.

stages.S5.rows.S5-2.text.value: Debrief fields: facts_used[claim ids], questions_landed[ids], band_accuracy{dim: hit|miss}, outcome. Nothing else is asked.

stages.S5.rows.S5-3.test.value: Run improve -- the only file written is evals/proposals/<date>.patch.

stages.S5.rows.S5-3.text.value: improve proposes row diffs (family weights, question templates, band phrases) as a patch with basis: debrief_id; it never edits SKILL.md and never lands a diff itself.
